interpretation: Direct anon/authenticated table access is blocked for the inspected core tables. One appointment-overlap view grants SELECT to browser roles, but it is security_invoker=true and its appointments base table denies browser SELECT with RLS enabled and a false policy; no application source references the view. This does not show a direct customer-row exposure. Because server APIs use privileged access, full tenant isolation still depends on application ownership guards; 41 guarded routes passed the static check, but a production cross-tenant runtime test was not performed.
